statusNote: Template only. Never applied or installed, and not usable as written: every <PLACEHOLDER> is filled on the authorized host under the readiness packet's authorizations. Nothing here is written to user, project, local or managed settings files.
deliveredAs: ACP session/new params from the ORCA client: mcpServers below, and options below as _meta.claudeCode.options

shellRowDelta.status: INACTIVE; only after the typed row passes and the shell row is separately authorized
shellRowDelta.sandboxNote: Network, filesystem and fallback sandbox keys for the selected binary are verified against its settings schema before the row is authorized; an unsandboxed fallback is a stop.
shellRowDelta.commandNote: Differs from the earlier PLAN's stdout-only command so that the effect is a line the independent counter can read. It needs explicit approval as written.

checkerContract.orcaAllow: exit 0 and print nothing: the documented no-decision result, so native permission (and its remembered approval) still decides
checkerContract.otherTools: deny every tool_name other than fixtureTool, and journal its route
checkerContract.journalFirst: append the hook.frame, policy.decision and hook.response rows to the operator journal before writing to stdout; a checker that cannot journal exits 1 so onFailure blocks

forbidden: permissionDecision allow (it skips the native prompt, so the native cache is never exercised)
permissionDecision defer (it ends the turn in -p runs)
bypassPermissions, acceptEdits, auto, dontAsk or plan mode
CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE or CLAUDE_MODEL_CONFIG in the adapter or session environment (the adapter merges CLAUDE_MODEL_CONFIG into settings)
settings given as a string (the adapter reads it as a file relative to the agent-writable cwd)
credentials, tokens or API keys in env, settings or args
any hook, settings or policy file inside the workspace
